items.s: Little made his sole field-goal attempt and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans on Sunday in London. Little made a 60-yard field goal with 1:55 left in the fourth quarter to tie the game 31-31. The Jaguars' kicker continues to deliver in big moments for the team whenever called upon. Little moves to 10-for-12 on field-goal attempts and 16-for-17 on PATs through six games in 2026.

items.h: Cam Little perfect in Week 6 loss
items.s: Cam Little connected on his lone field goal attempts and 4-of-4 extra point attempts in a 34-31 loss to Houston. Little connected on a 60-yard field goal for his lone make of the day. Little has missed just one kick this season and continues to show that he has one of the strongest legs in the game. Little and the Jaguars will head to their bye in Week 7.

Little made both of his field goals and went 1-for-2 on extra-point tries during the Jaguars' 19-17 win over the Eagles on Sunday in London. The Jaguars looked dead in the water after Eagles' kicker Jake Elliott connected on a 48-yard field goal to give Philadelphia a 17-16 lead with only eight seconds left in the fourth quarter. However, Ameer Abdullah gave Jacksonville hope with a 53-yard return on the ensuing kickoff, and Little answered the call with a 57-yard field goal to seal the victory for the Jaguars. Little is 9-for-11 on field-goal attempts through five regular-season games, with both of those misses coming from 50-plus yards. The Jaguars will stay in London for Week 6 to face…

items.h: Cam Little nails long game-winner in Week 5
items.s: Cam Little made both of his field-goal attempts and 1-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles. After missing a PAT that could have put the Jaguars up by three late in the fourth quarter, Little got a chance to make up for it with just one tick of the clock remaining during a wild finish Sunday. Little made good on the opportunity, drilling a 57-yard attempt as time expired to give the Jaguars a victory. That is Little's longest make of the season through five weeks, and he's now 9-of-11 overall on field goals for the campaign. He's one of the top kickers in the league.

items.h: Cam Little a Great Starting Option in London Face-off
items.s: Jacksonville Jaguars kicker Cam Little remains a solid fantasy starter heading into Week 5 against the Philadelphia Eagles. Little may have plenty of chances to show off his big leg to London fans, given the Eagles' defense hasn't been as good as in recent seasons. With injuries on offense as well, the Eagles will likely struggle to move the ball, giving Jacksonville more drives with good field position. Little came into the year with high fantasy expectations, and while he hasn't quite been top tier, those expectations should remain. items.h: Cam Little scores ten points in win Sunday
items.s: Cam Little went 3-for-3 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals. Little made all four of his kicks on Sunday, including one from 55 yards out, which left him with a nice fantasy total in this win over the Bengals. Fantasy managers should continue to view him as a good option at the kicker position moving forward.

Little went 3-for-3 on field-goal tries and made his only PAT during Sunday's 22-17 win over the Bengals. Little delivered a pair of field-goal makes from 55 and 28 yards in the first half before later adding another 54-yard make in the third quarter. The kicker has now gone 7-for-9 on field-goal tries, including 4-for-6 from 50-plus yards, and he figures to continue to get plenty of opportunities while finishing off the drives of Jacksonville's potent offense.

items.h: Cam Little totals five points in win Sunday
items.s: Cam Little made all five of his extra-point attempts and missed his lone field-goal attempt from 70 yards out in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots. Little ended up with just five points on Sunday, which is a little disappointing considering how easily scoring came to the Jaguars against New England. He also barely missed one kick from what would have been an NFL record 70-yards out, which further hurt his fantasy total in this matchup. He should bounce back in the near future.

Little hit all five of his extra-point attempts but missed a 70-yard field-goal try in Sunday's 35-6 win over the Patriots. The Jaguars lined up for what would have been a record-setting field goal just before halftime, but Little missed it wide right. The kicker has only failed to connect on two attempts this season, a 54-yard field-goal try and this 70-yard attempt. The Jaguars have been offering him plenty of scoring opportunities through three games, and it's clear that the team doesn't hesitate to test Little's strong leg either.

items.h: Cam Little Remains Reliable Kicking Option in Week 3
items.s: Jacksonville Jaguars kicker Cam Little remains a top fantasy kicking option entering Week 3 against the New England Patriots. He did miss a 54-yard field goal last week against the Denver Broncos, but has otherwise been reliable. The Jaguars offense remains potent enough to support a good fantasy kicker, and Little still has the leg to make long field goals. He may not be quite at the level of being a contender for top kicker in fantasy at the current moment, but he is still an easy start for fantasy managers.
